sloka: वज्रविद्रुमवैदूर्यमुकारजतसंहितान् ।विचित्रान् भवनान् धातून् स्यान्दमानान् ददर्श सः ।। 5.54.28 ।।।।
transliteration: vajravidrumavaidūryamukārajatasaṁhitān ।vicitrān bhavanān dhātūn syāndamānān dadarśa saḥ ।। 5.54.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Just as fire is not satisfied with dry sticks and grass Hanuman was not satisfied with the dead demons.
